全球气候治理正加速从“承诺时代”迈向“系统性行动时代”。


在这一关键历史节点，上海气候周2026将于2026年4月20日至28日在中国上海隆重举行。本届主题为“东方既白”，旨在以东方视角与全球协同，开启气候行动的新阶段。


今天，当气候变化、水资源压力与生态退化成为全球性挑战，人类再次意识到 - 食物，从来不是单一产业，而是连接农业、水、安全、健康与文明未来的核心系统。


谷雨，是二十四节气中唯一直接指向“食物诞生”的时节。 它象征的不只是农耕文明的时间节点，更是一套人与土地、水、气候与生命协同运行的系统智慧。


我们诚挚地邀请您参加将于2026年4月20日举行的2026年上海气候周核心主题论坛：“未来粮食系统：谷雨宣言 - 从餐桌重塑未来食物系统”。


论坛以未来粮食系统的转型为中心，将召集来自多边机构、行业、资本和政策领域的主要利益相关者，探讨亚洲农业食品转型的投资途径和系统性机遇。


我们相信，您在这一领域的深刻见解和丰富经验将为对话带来前瞻性和具有战略意义的视角，帮助加快农业食品系统从概念转变到可操作、可投资、可治理和可扩展的解决方案的过渡。

Global climate governance is rapidly transitioning from the “Era of Commitments” to an “Era of Systemic Action.”


At this pivotal moment, Shanghai Climate Week 2026 will be held in Shanghai, China, from April 20 to 28, 2026. Under the theme “Eastern Dawning” the event aims to open a new chapter in climate action through an Eastern perspective and global collaboration.


At the critical intersection of climate change, water stress, and ecosystem transformation, the food system is evolving from a traditional sector into a core system that connects agriculture, water, climate, and capital - emerging as one of the most strategically significant areas of transformation over the next decade.


We cordially invite you to attend the Shanghai Climate Week 2026 core theme forum: Future Food System: The Grain Rain Declaration - Reimagine Future Food Systems from Dining Table, to be held on April 20, 2026.


Centered on the transformation of future food systems, the forum will convene key stakeholders from multilateral institutions, industry, capital, and the policy sphere to explore investment pathways and systemic opportunities for Asia’s agri-food transition.


We are confident that your profound insights and extensive experience in this field will bring a forward-looking and strategically significant perspective to the dialogue, helping to accelerate the transition of agri-food systems from conceptual transformation to actionable, investable, governable, and scalable solutions.

Global climate governance is shifting from an “Era of Commitments” to an era of systemic action. From April 20 to 28, 2026, Shanghai Climate Week will be grandly convened at the Shanghai Eastern Hub under the theme “Eastern Dawning.” This is not merely a conference - it is a prototype of a global climate action operating system for 2035, integrating rule-making, industrial breakthroughs, foundational resilience, and leadership acceleration into one systemic engine.


We cordially invite you to attend the Shanghai Climate Week 2026 core theme forum – Innovation for Water Security in Asia and the Pacific Region. The forum will be held on April 21 2026 and will be supported by the Asia-Pacific Water Forum, the Asian Development Bank, UNESCO and other authoritative institutions, focusing on the core topic of "Innovation Drives Water Security: Climate Adaptation, Resilience and Sustainable Development".


The purpose of this annual forum is to build a regional action engine that connects strategy, finance and technology. The agenda will cover everything from jointly shaping the AWDO2025 Shanghai development strategy, urban water security investment and financing workshops, to cutting-edge innovation forums such as recycled seawater desalination and marine island resilience, committed to transforming macro commitments into bankable and practical solutions to jointly address water security challenges in the Asia-Pacific region.


We believe that your insights and practical experience in areas such as water governance, climate finance, sustainable technologies, and more will be of vital value to this high-level conversation that brings together policymakers, financial institutions, technology pioneers, and young innovators. Your participation will help drive practical cooperation and shape the new order of water security in the Asia-Pacific region.

title: 构建高效碳移除市场
titleEn: Building an Efficient CDR Market
description:
随着全球碳中和目标的推进，碳移除（CARBON DIOXIDE REMOVAL, CDR）技术作为实
现深度脱碳的关键路径，正受到国际社会的广泛关注。碳市场作为激励减排和推动绿色技术
创新的重要机制，其高效运作对于加速 CDR 技术的规模化应用至关重要。当前，全球碳移
除市场正处于快速发展和探索阶段，随着EVERSINK开发成功国内第一个PURO碳移除项目，
国内碳移除市场也在逐渐兴起。如何构建一个透明、高效、具有公信力的碳移除市场体系，
是业界共同面临的挑战与机遇。
descriptionEn: With the advancement of global carbon neutrality goals, Carbon Dioxide Removal (CDR) technology has garnered widespread attention from the international community as a key pathway to achieving deep decarbonization. The carbon market, as an important mechanism to incentivize emissions reduction and promote green technology innovation, plays a crucial role in accelerating the large-scale application of CDR technology. Currently, the global carbon removal market is in a rapid development and exploration phase. With EVERSINK successfully developing the first domestic PURO carbon removal project, the domestic carbon removal market is gradually emerging. How to build a transparent, efficient, and credible carbon removal market system is a challenge and opportunity that the industry collectively faces.

description:
在全球生态转型与“美丽中国”建设交汇的重要历史时期，我们正共同站在人与自然和谐共生的新文明起点。国家生态文明战略、“双碳”目标、乡村振兴与粮食安全蓝图，照亮了生态创新的前行之路。当下，我们依然面临着全球生态危机与气候挑战，这不仅是农业问题，更是深刻的文化命题——我们如何与土地共处，如何通过可持续生活方式的践行以及每一顿餐食的选择，定义新文明的未来。
为此，我们发起“2026守护大地峰会&生态生活创新艺术展”，这不仅仅是一场会议，更是一次对生态文明的深度叩问与探索，一次对中国生态力量的深度动员，一次对未来生活方式的集体创变与共生。
descriptionEn:
At a pivotal historical moment marked by the convergence of global ecological transformation and the vision of building a “Beautiful China,” we stand together at the threshold of a new civilization rooted in harmony between humanity and nature. National strategies on ecological civilization, the “dual carbon” goals, rural revitalization, and food security have illuminated the path forward for ecological innovation. Yet today, we continue to face global ecological crises and climate challenges. This is not merely an agricultural issue, but a profound cultural question—how we coexist with the land, and how we define the future of civilization through sustainable lifestyles and the choices we make at every meal.
In response, we are launching the “2026 Earth Stewardship Summit & Eco-Living Innovation Art Exhibition.” This is more than just a conference—it is a deep inquiry into ecological civilization, a powerful mobilization of China’s ecological forces, and a collective endeavor to reimagine and co-create future lifestyles in harmony with nature.

论坛将特别关注中国在生态保护修复、碳市场机制创新与农业及土地领域CDR技术研发应用等方面的探索，促进其与全球高诚信度规则和前沿科技趋势相接轨，从而为全球贡献融合了技术赋能、系统治理与市场创新的亚洲智慧与中国方案，最终实现生态健康、社会公平与气候目标的协同共赢。
descriptionEn:

We will bring together representatives from science, policy, industry, and finance to jointly explore nature-based solutions​ and their underlying technological innovation systems—particularly pathways such as Carbon Dioxide Removal (CDR). The forum will delve into how to scientifically and credibly transform the ecological and climate benefits generated by these approaches into high-quality carbon credit assets. It will also seek to promote the establishment of transparent and robust international market mechanisms to direct capital towards sustainable practices underpinned by technological support and tangible ecological benefits.

The forum will pay special attention to China's explorations in ecological conservation and restoration, carbon market mechanism innovation, and the R&D and application of CDR technologies in agriculture and land use. It aims to facilitate their alignment with global high-integrity rules and cutting-edge technological trends. In doing so, the forum seeks to contribute viable Asian wisdom and Chinese solutions to the world—solutions that integrate technological empowerment, systemic governance, and market innovation—ultimately achieving synergistic wins for ecological health, social equity, and climate goals.

titleEn: Cities Leading a Climate-Healthy Future: Technological Innovation, Sustainable Investment and Cross-Sector Partnerships
description: 气候变化正深刻影响城市健康与可持续发展。气温上升、极端天气频发、环境退化以及快速城市化，正对公共卫生体系和城市基础设施带来前所未有的挑战。城市已成为应对气候变化与健康风险的关键前沿。上海及亚洲主要城市在科技创新、产业发展和跨部门合作方面具有独特优势，有潜力通过数字健康、生物科技、绿色金融与城市规划等领域的协同创新，将气候挑战转化为建设健康与韧性城市的机遇。同时，极端高温、洪涝灾害以及新发传染病等气候相关风险，也要求城市建立更加前瞻和综合的公共卫生准备体系。本次分论坛由艾社康亚洲（ASKHealthAsia）与上海纽约大学城市设计与城市科学重点实验室（LOUD）共同主办，旨在汇聚政府、国际组织、发展金融机构、企业与社会组织代表，探讨技术创新、投资机制与社区参与如何共同推动气候韧性健康城市建设，并促进跨领域合作与行动。
descriptionEn:
Climate change is profoundly impacting urban health and sustainable development. Rising temperatures, increasingly frequent extreme weather events, environmental degradation, and rapid urbanization are posing unprecedented challenges to public health systems and urban infrastructure. Cities have become the critical frontline in addressing climate change and health risks.
Shanghai and other major Asian cities possess unique advantages in technological innovation, industrial development, and cross-sector collaboration. They have the potential to transform climate challenges into opportunities for building healthy and resilient cities through synergistic innovation in digital health, biotechnology, green finance, and urban planning. At the same time, climate-related risks such as extreme heat, flooding, and emerging infectious diseases demand that cities establish more forward-looking and integrated public health preparedness systems.
This sub-forum, co-hosted by ASKHealth Asia and the Laboratory of Urban Design and Urban Science (LOUD) at NYU Shanghai, aims to bring together representatives from government, international organizations, development finance institutions, enterprises, and social organizations to explore how technological innovation, investment mechanisms, and community engagement can jointly drive the development of climate-resilient healthy cities, and to promote cross-sectoral collaboration and action.

descriptionEn:

Its core purpose is not to select the hottest technologies, but to create and release credible investment direction signals systematically for industries, capital, and policies 5-10 years in advance, answering:
- Which technologies are crossing the 'demonstration-commercialization' threshold?
- Which scenarios are becoming new anchor points for capital allocation?
- Which companies possess 'climate infrastructure-level' strategic value?
Strategic positioning: Responding to China's 14th Five-Year Plan, deeply integrating green technology with artificial intelligence, and promoting 'Green × AI' as the core engine of new productive forces, consolidating Shanghai's leadership as the 'Eastern thrust point' for global green transformation.

我们诚挚地邀请您出席2026上海气候周核心活动：“绿色供应链转型：小巨人迈向绿色巨人”主题论坛。本次活动主题为“专精特新‘小巨人’迈向‘绿色巨人’”，旨在解码Scope 3，将供应链合规挑战转化为全球竞争力入口。


论坛将汇聚全球气候学院、全球赋能可持续发展倡议组织（GeSI）、世界可持续发展工商理事会（WBCSD）、气候债券倡议组织（CBI）、公众环境中心（IPE）、LEAD50、湖州银行及商道融绿等多方合作伙伴，并邀请链头企业、金融机构与“小巨人”企业代表。核心环节包括发布《中国SME Scope 3成熟度指数（2026版）》与“专精特新绿色供应链案例库”，并通过专题圆桌与平行实战工作坊，深入探讨数据披露、绿色金融与行业升级路径。


期待您能拨冗出席，共同塑造可复制的中国中小企业绿色转型方案。
invitationContentHtmlEn:
{salutationBlock}


Global climate governance is rapidly transitioning from the “Era of Commitments” to an “Era of Systemic Action.”


At this pivotal moment, Shanghai Climate Week 2026 will be held in Shanghai, China, from April 20 to 28, 2026. Under the theme “Eastern Dawning” the event aims to open a new chapter in climate action through an Eastern perspective and global collaboration.


We sincerely invite you to be a guest speaker at the 2026 Shanghai Climate Week "Green Supply Chain Transformation" theme forum. The event will be held on April 25 2026, with the theme of "Specialized, Special and New 'Little Giant' Towards 'Green Giant'", designed to decode Scope 3 and transform supply chain compliance challenges into global competitive entry points.


The forum will bring together partners such as the Global Climate Institute, GeSI, WBCSD, CBI, the Center for Public Environment, LEAD50, Bank of Huzhou and SynTao Green Finance, and invite representatives of chain enterprises, financial institutions and "little giant" enterprises. The core links include the release of the "China SME Scope 3 Maturity Index" and the "Specialized and New Green Supply Chain Case Library", and through special roundtables and parallel practical workshops, in-depth discussions on data disclosure, Green finance and industry upgrading paths.


We believe that your deep experience and forward-looking insights in green supply chains, sustainable transformation, or related fields will provide key inspiration for attendees to build a "collaborative flywheel" ecosystem. Your sharing will help SMEs turn their emission reduction efforts into financing advantages and market competitiveness.


We look forward to your time attending and jointly shaping a replicable green transformation plan for Chinese SMEs.

descriptionEn:
The "Sustainable Development Talent Program" is an educational initiative launched by the United Nations Institute for Training and Research (UNITAR) Prosperity Alliance Shanghai Center (Unitar PAS). It brings together authoritative global resources in sustainable development, providing participants with opportunities for professional learning, social practice, and comprehensive skill demonstration. Among its offerings, the CPSD Arts Practice track is specifically designed by Unitar PAS for participants exploring the intersection of "sustainability + art." Led by contemporary pioneering sustainable artists, it conveys the power and vitality of art through diverse artistic forms.

This event will gather pioneering sustainable artists and outstanding works, offering participants an extraordinary audiovisual experience. We sincerely invite those who value lifestyle aesthetics and care about sustainable development to join us in exploring ecology, society, and the future through art, and to collectively advocate for a responsible and aesthetically enriching way of life.

description:
气候变化正深刻影响城市健康与可持续发展。气温上升、极端天气频发、环境退化以及快速城市化，正对公共卫生体系和城市基础设施带来前所未有的挑战。城市已成为应对气候变化与健康风险的关键前沿。
上海及亚洲主要城市在科技创新、产业发展和跨部门合作方面具有独特优势，有潜力通过数字健康、生物科技、绿色金融与城市规划等领域的协同创新，将气候挑战转化为建设健康与韧性城市的机遇。同时，极端高温、洪涝灾害以及新发传染病等气候相关风险，也要求城市建立更加前瞻和综合的公共卫生准备体系。
本次分论坛由艾社康亚洲（ASK Health Asia）与上海纽约大学城市设计与城市科学重点实验室（LOUD）共同主办，旨在汇聚政府、国际组织、发展金融机构、企业与社会组织代表，探讨技术创新、投资机制与社区参与如何共同推动气候韧性健康城市建设，并促进跨领域合作与行动。
descriptionEn:
Climate change is profoundly affecting urban health and sustainable development. Rising temperatures, frequent extreme weather events, environmental degradation, and rapid urbanization are posing unprecedented challenges to public health systems and urban infrastructure. Cities have become a critical frontier in addressing climate change and health risks.
Shanghai and major cities in Asia have unique advantages in technological innovation, industrial development, and cross-sector collaboration, with the potential to transform climate challenges into opportunities for building healthy and resilient cities through collaborative innovation in areas such as digital health, biotechnology, green finance, and urban planning. At the same time, climate-related risks such as extreme heat, flooding disasters, and emerging infectious diseases require cities to establish more forward-looking and comprehensive public health preparedness systems.
This sub-forum is co-hosted by ASK Health Asia and the Key Laboratory of Urban Design and Urban Science at New York University Shanghai, aiming to bring together representatives from governments, international organizations, development finance institutions, businesses, and social organizations to discuss how technological innovation, investment mechanisms, and community participation can jointly promote the construction of climate-resilient healthy cities and facilitate cross-sector collaboration and action.

description: 在全球气候治理与“双碳”目标纵深推进的背景下，公共建筑的绿色低碳运行已成为城市更新的重要命题。如何让既有建筑在运行中实现碳中和？路径不是预设的蓝图，而是在政策引导、技术赋能、资本协同与运营实践中持续“生成”的动态答案。会议将探讨在“十五五”开启的关键窗口期，如何回答既有建筑的“碳中和”之问。
descriptionEn: Against the backdrop of global climate governance and the deepening of the 'dual carbon' goals, the green and low-carbon operation of public buildings has become an important topic in urban renewal. How can existing buildings achieve carbon neutrality in their operations? descriptionEn: Since its establishment in 1901 as the world's first national standards body, BSI has always been at the forefront of international standard development.
